findings.highlight: Because the two of them knew Kazusa’s own gradual response wouldn’t amount to much.
findings.evidenceJa: 二人とも、かずさの追々々試対応でそれどころではなかったから
findings.explanation: Both of them were too occupied dealing with Kazusa's repeated re-re-retests to help with the plan; the translation invents a prediction about Kazusa's gradual response.
findings.japanese:
「それだけ消耗してる割にはあまり役に立たなかったけどな」

「お前ら元気だな…」

「鍛え方が違うからな。特にここ二月は寝る暇もなかったし」

「十一月は俺のせいだったけど、十二月は自業自得だろ…」

　この日までの数日間、この計画のために動いていたのは本当に雪菜だけだった。

　他の二人は『温泉…？』というツッコミ以外はほぼ全てを雪菜に委ねていた。

「ほんと、今年を思い返してみても、いろいろと大変だったよね。さ、飲も飲も」

「忘年会のノリになってるぞ雪菜」

「この状況は明らかに忘年会だろ。これをクリスマスパーティなんて言ったら欧米人に怒られる」

　二人とも、かずさの追々々試対応でそれどころではなかったから。

　雪菜のすることをある程度は信頼していたから。
findings.todokanai:
“You’re weirdly exhausted for someone who didn’t help at all.”

“You two are pretty perky…”

“We’re just differently trained. I’ve hardly had any time to sleep the past two months.”

“I’ll take the blame for November, but you brought it on yourself in December…”

In the past few days, Setsuna was really the only one who had taken any action concerning this plan.

The other two left just about everything up to her, apart from replying, ‘Hot springs…?’

“Wow, thinking back on it, this year was rough! C’mon, let’s start drinking!”

“You’re getting into year-end-party mode, Setsuna.”

“This is obviously a year-end party. Calling this a Christmas party would tick off the Westerners.”

Because the two of them knew Kazusa’s own gradual response wouldn’t amount to much.

Because they were confident in what Setsuna was doing, to a certain extent.

findings.highlight: Kazusa, after turning toward the passenger seat and giving a small wave
findings.evidenceJa: 運転席に向かって軽く手を振ると、かずさも軽く返し
findings.explanation: Haruki waves toward the driver's seat and Kazusa returns the wave. The translation makes Kazusa initiate it and turns her toward the now-empty passenger seat.
findings.japanese:
「じゃあ、な」

「ああ…」

　そして今、素っ気ない別れの挨拶を済ませ、春希は車から降り。

「………」

「………」

　トランクから旅行鞄を取り出し、ゆっくりと肩に担ぎ。

「………」

「………」

　運転席に向かって軽く手を振ると、かずさも軽く返し、車を発進させる。
findings.todokanai:
“Well, see you later.”

“Yeah…”

And now, their curt parting words exchanged, Haruki got out of the car.

“…”

“…”

Took his travel bag out of the trunk, slowly slung it over his shoulder.

“…”

“…”

And Kazusa, after turning toward the passenger seat and giving a small wave, turned back, started the car, and set off.

findings.highlight: after being kept waiting for two weeks
findings.evidenceJa: 二日間おあずけを喰らっていた犬
findings.explanation: 二日間 is two days, not two weeks; the error multiplies the separation central to the simile by seven.
findings.japanese:
まるで二日間おあずけを喰らっていた犬がようやくご褒美にありつけたかのように、ひたすらご主人様の匂いを確かめ、ついでに自分の匂いをマーキングしているようで。

「かずさ…お前、いい匂いするな」

　だから、そんなひたむきで、けれど少し動物的な行為に、春希はあくまで人間的…というか、飼い主的なおおらかさをもって抱きしめる。

「…キモい、春希」

「ま、否定はしない」

　…過剰な照れ隠しで手を噛まれても受け止められるくらいなおおらかさをもって。

「俺、お前のことに関してはキモいかもしれない。オタクかもしれない」

「お前なぁ…そういうの、本当にキモいぞ」

「だから、否定してないじゃん」

「まさかそんなわざとらしいこと言われて嬉しがる女がいるとでも思ってるのか？」
findings.todokanai:
Like a dog who had finally been given her reward after being kept waiting for two weeks, single-mindedly taking in her master’s scent, and marking him with her own scent at the same time.

“Kazusa… You smell good.”

And so, faced with this earnest, slightly animalistic behavior, Haruki took a completely human action—or, perhaps, showed a generosity befitting an owner—and embraced her.

“…You’re gross, Haruki.”

“Well, I won’t deny that.”

…Generous enough that he could accept having his hand bitten, in an exaggerated attempt to hide embarrassment.

“Maybe I am gross when it comes to you. Maybe I’m a total obsessive creep.”

“The fact that you’re even saying that is… gross.”

“Like I said, I won’t deny it.”

“You think there’s a single girl who would be happy hearing you say something that forced?”

findings.highlight:
“So, then, um…”

“Kazusa…”

Up to this point, just the dependency had been enough.

Saying “two members of a trio” was enough.

But this was the divide.
findings.evidenceJa:
「なら、ならさ…」

「かずさ…」

　ここまではまだ甘えで済んだ。

　〝三人の中の二人〟と言ってもよかった。

　けれど、ここが分水嶺だった。
findings.explanation: Up to this point, Haruki and Kazusa's conduct could still be written off as seeking affection within the trio; 'the dependency had been enough' replaces that moral threshold with a claim about dependency satisfying them.
findings.japanese:
「なら、ならさ…」

「かずさ…」

　ここまではまだ甘えで済んだ。

　〝三人の中の二人〟と言ってもよかった。

　けれど、ここが分水嶺だった。
findings.todokanai:
“So, then, um…”

“Kazusa…”

Up to this point, just the dependency had been enough.

Saying “two members of a trio” was enough.

But this was the divide.

findings.highlight: You don’t even have to say it…
findings.explanation: Kazusa says she will not say that it hurts. The translation instead tells Haruki that he does not have to say something, reversing speaker intent and the exchange's consent language.
findings.japanese:
――こいつは、あたしのだ。

　　もう、どこにも行かない、あたしだけの…

「痛いって言っても、やめないぞ…？」

「言うもんか」

　だから、後のことは春希に任せればいい。

　自分はただ、彼にどこまでもじゃれついていればいい…

　――いいよな、雪菜…？

　　お前、あたしたちのこと、認めてくれたんだよな？

　　だから、何も問題なんかないよな…？
findings.todokanai:
He’s mine.

All mine. He isn’t going anywhere…

“I’m not going to stop, even if you say it hurts.”

“You don’t even have to say it…”

Which meant that she could leave the rest to Haruki.

All she had to do was cling to Haruki, wherever he might go…

This is okay, right, Setsuna?

You gave us your blessing, right?

So, there shouldn’t be any problem, right…?
